title: Founder Live Execution Boundary
objective: Keep the founder chat surface clean while defining the next governed boundary between local founder planning and future live execution authority.
safetyRules: No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No raw private project IDs in primary Command Center UX.
No full Command Center demo leakage.
reuseRequired: existing dashboard cards, tabs, badges, evidence, audit, and activity helpers

subphases.title: Chat Surface Consolidation
subphases.narrowGoal: Make Chat with NEXUS a clean chat-only route and move PRD, DB, live-use, handoff, work-admission, and agent-flow detail back to dedicated pages.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.uiShape: Chat route renders only Chat with NEXUS, founder message textarea, Send, Reset, prompt starters, answered/missing count, and a short planning-only safety note.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: The Chat with NEXUS route must stay focused on chat only. PRD, DB, work admission, live-use, handoff, execution admission, persistence, and agent detail must remain on Business Build, Agent Flow, Live Readiness, Database, or other corresponding pages.
subphases.themeRequirements: Preserve existing dark, light, and system theme behavior. Do not introduce theme-specific layout forks.
subphases.playwrightTests: Update route tests so Chat asserts non-chat panels are absent, while dedicated route tests continue covering the moved panels.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Document P104.1 complete, P104 in progress, and P104.2 next.
subphases.phaseStatusUpdate: P104 in progress; P104.1 complete; current P104.1; previous P103.7; next P104.2.
validationCommands: cd dashboard && npx playwright test tests/routes.spec.js --grep "Command Center Lite route renders interactive founder chat|Command Center Lite route stays chat-only|Founder DB workflow appears in Business Build and DB Runtime|Business Build DB CRUD state appears in Business Build, Agent Flow, and DB Runtime|Founder live work admission appears across founder routes|full Command Center demo leakage safety"
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm Chat contains only chat-specific UI.
Confirm dedicated pages still expose PRD, DB, agent, and live-work detail.
Confirm no raw private IDs, raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, or full Command Center demo leakage.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): clean founder chat surface"

subphases.title: Execution Boundary Schema
subphases.narrowGoal: Define local execution-boundary records, required evidence, approval predicates, forbidden actions, and blocked execution flags without enabling execution.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.envelope: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, source P103 phases, boundaryRecordShape, laneRecordShape, requiredEvidence, forbiddenActions, approvalPredicateCount, blocked execution flags, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, and commandCenterVisible false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: No UI source change in P104.2. Future P104.4 UX must render execution-boundary readiness on non-chat pages without raw dumps, private IDs, or runnable execution controls.
subphases.playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P104.2 because no UI files change.
checkerUpdates: Keep check:p1041-chat-surface-consolidation forward-compatible with later P104 subphases.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Record P104.2 complete and P104.3 next.
subphases.phaseStatusUpdate: P104 in progress; P104.2 complete; current P104.2; previous P104.1; next P104.3.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm all execution flags are false.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define founder live execution boundary schema"

subphases.title: Execution Boundary Model
subphases.narrowGoal: Build deterministic local execution-boundary state from P103 work admissions and the P104.2 schema without enabling execution.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.envelope: Result envelope with schemaVersion, source schema/work admission phases, founderContextSummary, boundaryReadiness, boundaryRows[], requiredEvidence, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible true, and all execution flags false.
